title: Kyv Sharpshooters: Jaeth, Mihl and Nass
summary: Three linked sharpshooters must be defeated as one encounter.
overview: Three linked sharpshooters must be defeated as one encounter.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Engaging one sharpshooter can pull the other two into combat.
Each becomes mobile at 45% health, so prepare tanks to follow the change.
Finish all three; the first deaths remove their own loot while another sharpshooter remains.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
